Creates an app for the workspace, optionally with its tester groups and their members and its CodePush deployments. Nested resources are created one by one, so the app is created even when some of them cannot be: the response then carries an `errors` array of `{code, message, details}`. `code` says what failed (`ERR_TESTER_GROUP_NOT_CREATED`, `ERR_INTERNAL_TESTER_NOT_ADDED`, `ERR_EXTERNAL_TESTER_NOT_ADDED` or `ERR_CODE_PUSH_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_CREATED`), `details` names the group, member or deployment it is about, and `details.reason` carries the underlying cause. Note this is a different shape from the slug-keyed `errors` hash returned by add-testers.
